subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors.
stimulus: My attention was next to the cage in (a) ----- there were two big snakes. They seem to be asleep. (b) ----- I was thinking (c) ----- any one of them could get at me. It would have smashed my bones coiling itself round. The sight of the snakes made my blood creep. Then I was glad to go away from them (d) ----- turned my eyes from them at a porcupine. It had long quills sticking out. I then saw some deer (e) ----- beautiful eyes attracted me.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors: (a) which; (b) But; (c) if; (d) and; (e) whose.
